descriptionHtml:
缺陷 B17 · P1 · 新

出错时直接把服务器原始报错给医生看（「[CONVEX A(ai/vision:scanPriorNote)] … Server Error … 404」）；识图失败时还会把 AI 服务商的原文（可能带 Google 项目 / 服务账号）传到浏览器

票：TFA-94745 ready for qa；TFA-94425 ready for qa · 算 QA bug：是 · 在哪发现：本地

同一个 bug的其他用例（只算一次）：TC-13/S28

思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S30 「provider 失败绝不把凭据或 service account 身份带到客户端」 A provider failure never carries a credential or a service-account identity to the client

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U1a No long-lived provider API key or credential (AWS, OpenAI, Google Vertex service account, Deepgram, SES) is present anywhere in client code: the web bundle and its served source maps, the iOS and And …（UAT OAT-05 step 1；TFA-94700 AC 5；TFA-94700 description ('No API keys client-side … UAT OAT-05 step 1')；TFA-94423 AC 1）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given The UAT commit's error paths: convex/ai/providers/vertex.ts toVertexConvexError (detail = first line of err.message, up to 300 characters), convex/ai/providers/bedrockErrors.ts toBedrockConvexError (class, name and status only), convex/lib/ses.ts (SES delivery errors), and the OpenAI path covered by S12's 'provider fa …

When Code-review each mapper and trace its ConvexError data to the client (action result over the WebSocket, error toast). The proposed unit test feeds each mapper a provider message holding the sentinels 'AKIAQAOAT05SENTINEL1', 'qa-sa@qa-proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com' and 'sk-proj-QAOAT05'.

Then No ConvexError data and no client-visible text contains a sentinel, an access key ID, a service-account email, a project ID or a key.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：UAT OAT-05 step 1 'no provider API key … anywhere in client-side/browser code' and S01's pattern list ('.iam.gserviceaccount.com' and 'AKIA' are Fails there). A mapper that forwards provider message text able to carry any sentinel to the client is a Fail, quoted with file and line; …

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S30 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

分诊（2026-10-14）：1 条。

问题分类：新的产品问题 · 环境 本地 · 票 TFA-94423 ready for qa；TFA-94700 ready for qa

照片识别失败时，服务器会把 AI 服务商的原始报错（可能带 Google 项目名或服务账号）传到医生的浏览器；OpenAI 转写和邮件中转在 Convex 不隐藏普通错误的环境下也一样。

When photo reading fails, the server passes the AI provider's raw error line, which can name the Google project or service account, to the physician's browser; OpenAI transcription and the email relay do the same wherever Convex does not hide plain errors.

依据：allure d5abcb91-…-result.json; code-review lane. vertex.ts:135/168 copies up to 300 characters of the provider message into ConvexError data.detail. retry.ts:182 and phi.ts:191-196 rethrow it unchanged to the client (scanCensusSheet, scanClinicSchedule, scanPriorNote). openai.ts:19 / transcribe.ts:162 forward OpenAI's error.message (a 401 echoes a masked key), and email.ts:47 forwards the relay error. Clean paths: Bedrock, SES, live session. The S30 oracle says 'No recorded gap or open question applies', and it is not in the dev report. The S05 network capture is the runtime check.

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：code-review。

UAT item: OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-05/S30

A provider failure never carries a credential or a service-account identity to the client

Tickets: TFA-94423 Implement GPT-live medical mode for active dictation (ready for qa); TFA-94700 Physician Settings & AI Consent (store requirements) (ready for qa)

本地新 lane code-review：code-review/results.json 里 status failed → 失败·产品（失败·产品（lane 没写 productIssue，按它的 physicianImpact 算））。

Detail:

Fail. The Vertex mapper, toVertexConvexError, copies the first line of the provider's error message (up to 300 characters) into ConvexError data.detail (vertex.ts:135). invokeVision throws it on any failure (vertex.ts:168). Both vision()'s runWithRetry (retry.ts:183) and the aiAction wrapper (phi.ts:191-196) pass it on unchanged. ConvexError data always reaches the client, so the photo scans (scanCensusSheet, scanClinicSchedule, scanPriorNote) hand provider-controlled text to the browser. Google error lines name resource paths such as projects/<id>/locations/..., so a project ID can get through, and so can a service-account email or a sentinel if the provider message holds one. The OpenAI batch transcription path also forwards OpenAI's own error.message (apiErrorMessage, openai.ts:19; transcribe.ts:162). An OpenAI 401 echoes a partly masked sk-proj key, and the comment at openai.ts:6-7 says this text is meant to reach the physician. That one is a plain Error, which Convex normally hides from clients on production deployments, so it reaches the client on dev and preview, and on production only if that hiding is off. The Specode email relay does the same with the relay's payload.error (email.ts:42-47), under the same caveat. Clean paths: Bedrock sends only the kind, error name and HTTP status (bedrockErrors.ts:92); SES sends only the HTTP status (ses.ts:123); the live-session path sends fixed text plus the HTTP status (transcribe.ts:105-106). No recorded gap or open question applies.

产品问题（按 physicianImpact）：lane 没写 productIssue，失败·产品按它的 physicianImpact 算（全文见下）。

新发现（newFindings）：

  • apps/web/convex/ai/providers/vertex.ts:135: The Vertex mapper puts the first line of the provider's error message (up to 300 characters) into ConvexError data, which reaches the client.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/providers/vertex.ts:168: Any error from the Vertex SDK call is turned into that ConvexError and thrown out of invokeVision.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/providers/retry.ts:182: Vision has no fallback model, so runWithRetry rethrows the last error (the Vertex ConvexError) without changing it.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/phi.ts:191: The aiAction wrapper rethrows the original error untouched to the client and only reduces the audit-log copy to a class.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/openai.ts:19: apiErrorMessage returns OpenAI's own error.message, and the comment says it is meant to surface to the physician.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/transcribe.ts:162: The batch transcription path throws OpenAI's own error message text. It is a plain Error, so whether the client sees it depends on Convex hiding plain Error text in production.
  • apps/web/convex/email.ts:47: The Specode email relay puts the relay's own error string into the thrown message. It is a plain Error, so whether the client sees it depends on production hiding.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/providers/vertex.ts:135: The Vertex mapper copies the first line of the provider's error message, up to 300 characters, into the ConvexError data.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/providers/vertex.ts:168: invokeVision wraps any Google SDK error with toVertexConvexError, so the raw SDK message becomes the detail.
  • apps/web/convex/lib/phi.ts:191: The public aiAction wrapper rethrows the error unchanged to the client. Only the audit log gets a classification.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/transcribe.ts:162: The batch transcription path throws OpenAI's own error.message text, through apiErrorMessage, to the client as a plain Error.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/openai.ts:19: apiErrorMessage returns the provider's error.message as is and says it is what surfaces to the physician.
  • apps/web/convex/email.ts:47: The Specode relay's own error string is put into the thrown message.
  • apps/web/convex/ai/openai.ts:108: callOpenAI does not catch OpenAI SDK errors, so the SDK's message reaches the aiAction rethrow unchanged.

开放问题（openQuestions）：

  • Does the production Convex deployment hide plain Error messages from clients? That decides whether the OpenAI transcription text (transcribe.ts:162) and the Specode relay text (email.ts:47) reach clients in production. The Vertex ConvexError detail reaches them either way.
  • Does any client toast print error.data.detail? Showing it on screen is not needed for the fail, because the data is already in the WebSocket frame.
  • Does the UAT deployment run in Convex production mode, which replaces plain Error messages (transcribeAudio, the email relay, callOpenAI) with a generic server error? ConvexError data, such as the Vertex detail, is never replaced.
  • Does the client show ConvexError data.detail in a toast, or does it only travel in the WebSocket frame? The oracle treats either as a Fail.

代码定不了（notDecidableByCode）：

  • What text Vertex, OpenAI and the Specode relay actually put in their error messages at runtime (for example, whether a service-account email or a full key ever appears). The S05 network capture of response bodies and WebSocket frames is the runtime check.
  • Whether the Convex deployment the client talks to hides plain Error messages (production versus dev or preview).
  • What text Google Vertex, OpenAI and the Specode relay actually put in their error messages at runtime (for example, whether a permission-denied message names the service account or the project).
  • The S05 network capture of response bodies and WebSocket frames.

对医生的影响（physicianImpact）：When a photo scan (census sheet, clinic schedule or prior note) fails at Vertex, the browser receives Google's raw error line in the error data. That line can contain the Google Cloud project ID and, in IAM denials, a service-account email, both of which are visible in the network traffic or devtools. On non-production deployments, a failed recorded-audio transcription can also show OpenAI's error text, which can include a partly masked API key. / When a census, schedule or prior-note photo scan fails on Vertex, Google's own error text (which can name the service-account email or the GCP project) is sent to the physician's browser or phone. The client may also show it in an error toast. On a dev deployment, OpenAI and email-relay error text can reach the client the same way.

审查结论（verdict）：fail

证据：附了 2 个。

Dev run: skipped: not runnable on dev — not-runnable-on-dev: scripted-spec (manual: doc-review). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
